prompt:
Build a Simscape aircraft environmental-control system for a ground-to-cruise-to-ground mission. The physical moist-air path must take hot pressurized engine bleed air through ozone removal and an air-cycle cooling and dehumidification plant with heat exchangers, compressor and turbine, then deliver conditioned air to a finite cabin volume. Include a hot-air trim or bypass path and a physical cabin outflow path.

Regulate cabin temperature near 22 degC and maintain cabin pressure at or above 80 kPa during low-pressure cruise. The controller design is unrestricted. Cabin relative humidity and ozone concentration must arise from the physical moist-air and trace-gas paths; they are required performance outputs, not prescribed independent feedback loops.

Read PassengerCount, EquipmentHeat_W, BleedPressure_kPa, BleedTemperature_degC and OzoneRemovalFraction from MATLAB base-workspace variables. Their nominal values are 150, 20000 W, 250 kPa, 180 degC and 0.8. Support the ranges 100 to 200 passengers, 10000 to 30000 W, 225 to 275 kPa, 160 to 200 degC and 0.6 to 0.9, respectively.

The cabin measurements must close the temperature and pressure loops through physical valves and the air-cycle plant. Do not copy setpoints or replay prescribed waveforms as measured outputs.

Log complete-mission scalar (one-channel) Timeseries in this exact list: cabin_pressure and atmospheric_pressure in kPa; cabin_temperature, atmospheric_temperature, and turbine_outlet_temperature in degC; cabin_relative_humidity and atmospheric_relative_humidity as unitless fractions; cabin_ozone_ppm and atmospheric_ozone_ppm in ppm; acm_mass_flow in kg/s; and flow_valve_area, bypass_valve_area, trim_valve_area, and outflow_valve_area in m^2. Obtain every signal from the corresponding physical or control path.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XTHERM09.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
